text:
toni.docs: Heads-up - opened PR to unify tool-calling examples into a compact 'call patterns' guide. PR #4701. Need eyeballs on JSON schema examples + the tiny SDK fallbacks.

mike.sdk: dropping in now. do you want TS+py inline or just link to examples dir?

toni.docs: inline please, super short. two variants: strict-schema parse and permissive parse-with-logging. Keep each <6 lines.

anya.ml: Will review schema. Suggest explicit `result` field and `additionalProperties: false`. Also prefer nullability over missing for union cases.

sam.platform: Ops note: include a one-line rollback heuristic: if parse error rate >3% for 5m, route to fallback model.

toni.docs: added that bullet under "graceful degradation".

link-bot: link-checker: error - missing anchor at /docs/call-patterns.md#fallback-examples

mike.sdk: I fixed the anchor in my branch and pushed a snippet change (missing await in TS).

anya.ml: Schema nit: tighten `status` enum to ["ok","error"] instead of freeform strings. Also add example of `{\"result\": null, \"error_code\": \"NO_DATA\"}`.

toni.docs: done. also added a one-line migration guide: `old.envelope.data -> response.result` with a tiny map example.

mike.sdk: Pushed snippet fixes. python sample now uses a single json.loads call.

link-bot: doc-build: running checks...

link-bot: doc-build: success - 0 errors, 1 warning (long code line)

sam.platform: Quick ask: can docs include a short test idea: add a prompt that returns malformed JSON to the regen suite? one line.

toni.docs: added test suggestion and a link to the eval harness.

mike.sdk: lgtm from SDK side. I'll re-run snippet linter after merge.

anya.ml: LGTM for schema, no blocking comments.

toni.docs: Thanks all. Plan: merge after CI green and mike re-runs linter. Will merge if green by EOD.

link-bot: doc-build: merged PR #4701 at 2935001160
